credit.beta_body: Signet and test ledger only. This is not a production loan and it does not move mainnet funds.
credit.non_custodial: BitTasker does not hold the dollars or the keys.
credit.off_body: This build does not include the credit beta.
credit.partial_guard: A live repayment that splits one USDT coin is not sent. Partial sends can lose the change. The test ledger settles the split without broadcasting.
credit.net_note: The advance already paid to the tasker is what the lender receives back from the escrow, plus the fee. The two release amounts add up to the escrow.
credit.live_body: Nothing is sent from this page. An escrow or an advance is funded only after a confirmation. Unlock the wallet on the wallet page first if you want to read coins.
credit.tx_confirmed: Confirmed. This can be treated as funded.
credit.tx_unconfirmed: Not confirmed. This is not funded.
credit.wallet_locked: The wallet is locked. Open the wallet and unlock it, then come back. This page will not ask for the passkey.
credit.wallet_empty: No USDT coin is open in this wallet.
credit.coin_exact: This whole coin can be named as one transfer.
credit.offers_live: Offers in this beta are matched on the test ledger.
